steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for configuring auction strategy.
Configure the auction as Price Based with lot awarding.
Apply the first available pricing template.
Add one item so the vendor view has a per-item bid price to compare.
Complete the pricing sheet for the item.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite at least two vendors so a lowest competing bid exists.
Confirm the auction reached a real published project page.
Submit the first vendor's higher bid.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's lower bid, establishing the lowest price.
Confirm the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Verify the vendor bidding screen shows the lowest bid price for the item.
Verify the vendor bidding screen does not show a rank.
